description: Verify a change is adequately tested before it ships: run the tests, measure line coverage on the changed projects, and confirm every acceptance criterion has a covering test. Use when the user says "is this tested enough", "check the coverage for MN-42", "are all the ACs covered", "verify the tests before the PR", "run the QE checks", or "is this story gate-ready". Do NOT use to WRITE the implementation or the tests (that is create-code-generation), to derive or number the criteria (that is elaboration-upsert-user-story-acceptance-criteria), or to review code style (that is the review step).
